scope: P2 preparation only, final train600 model fitting and input-only execution planning
hypothesis: C minus B final aggregate accuracy on independently sampled questions
reward_observation: Three original generation repetitions per question, empirical mean over repetitions
features: MiniLM-L6 frozen 384D, PCA16 and StandardScaler fit on train600 only, leading intercept
regularization_source: E17 frozen full600 rule, median of five frozen M4 coefficients, verified against FULL600_FIT_LOG; no n600 rescaling
penalty: regularization times squared Frobenius norm, including intercept
empirical_max_targets: Uniform weights over all exact empirical maximizers
T_definition: All20 empirical mean rewards equal, training rows only
T_row_weight: beta on T, 1 otherwise; retain all600 rows and divide by600
sensitivity_decoder: raw floating point exact argmax, uniform over exact maxima
independent_unit: Original question, retaining all generation repetitions inside one cluster
power_test: Two-sided fixed-time paired mean comparison with task-stratified variance; approximate planning only
multiplicity: Single primary comparison. Raw-exact is a declared diagnostic. Additional co-primary tests require familywise control and new approval before outcomes.
confidence_interval_execution: No new CI or CI-only bootstrap in this E20 preparation, following the latest standing user instruction
access_allowed: Existing source, exposure and cache identity metadata
execution_requirement: Required actions are the positive-probability support union of frozen B/C policies, including the raw-exact diagnostic; shared members and identical aggregations reused
cache_rule: Reuse only matching question, physical member/action, generation seed, frozen model, prompt, generation and aggregation operator identities
completion_boundary: Prepare reports, publish de-identified artifacts and await user approval for actual P2 evaluation
